one_line: Ton Kham Borgohain, Ahom commander, and Turbak Khan, invading general, clash amid early cannon warfare at Hadira Chowki in 1532.

appearance.age_look: Ton Kham looks late 20s to early 30s with a lean, athletic build; Turbak looks late 30s to early 40s with a broad, battle-hardened build.
appearance.face: Ton Kham has a slim oval face, medium-brown Assamese complexion, sharp dark eyes, straight nose, and a calm but intense default expression with slightly furrowed brows; Turbak has a square, weathered face, wheat-brown complexion, fuller nose, short trimmed beard and moustache, and a stern, commanding default expression.
appearance.hair: Ton Kham’s black hair is tied back in a neat topknot at the back of the head and wrapped with a narrow white cloth band; Turbak’s dark brown hair is shoulder-length, straight, partly hidden beneath a simple conical steel helmet with a small nasal bar and a padded cloth coif underneath.
appearance.costume: Ton Kham wears a knee-length, front-wrapped cotton tunic in muted indigo with a V-neck and side slits, over a long-sleeved cream cotton undershirt, a deep-red woven sash tightly wrapped around his waist, narrow off-white cotton trousers tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots; over the tunic he has a fitted brown leather lamellar cuirass with small overlapping rectangular plates laced together, and plain leather bracers, plus a simple beaded thread around his neck and small brass ear-studs; Turbak wears a long quilted cotton coat (coat-of-padded armour) in dusty olive green reaching mid-calf, vertically stitched, belted with a dark leather belt, over a pale beige tunic and wide dark brown trousers, with sturdy black leather boots, a simple steel breastplate strapped over the quilted coat, and plain leather forearm guards, along with a narrow dark scarf at his neck and a few understated metal rings on his fingers.
appearance.signature: Ton Kham carries a long matchlock musket with a dark wooden stock, iron barrel, and a lit matchcord held in his left hand, plus a small powder horn at his belt, while Turbak grips a slightly curved single-edged sword with a plain steel blade and simple crossguard in his right hand and stands beside a small wheeled bronze cannon with wooden carriage and rope lashings.

ref_desc: Ton Kham Borgohain is a lean, medium-brown Assamese commander with a black topknot wrapped in a white band, indigo tunic, red sash, leather lamellar armour, and a long matchlock musket, while Turbak Khan is a broader, bearded general in an olive quilted coat, steel helmet, simple breastplate, curved sword, and a small bronze cannon beside him, all in muted indigo, deep red, cream, olive green, and brown leather tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of two opposing historical commanders from 16th-century northeast India standing near a riverside battlefield: Ton Kham Borgohain is a lean, medium-brown Assamese man with a slim oval face, sharp dark eyes, and a calm intense expression, his black hair tied into a neat topknot wrapped with a narrow white band; he wears a knee-length muted indigo cotton tunic with a V-neck and side slits over a cream long-sleeved undershirt, a deep-red woven sash tight at his waist, off-white narrow trousers tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots, and a fitted brown leather lamellar cuirass with overlapping plates plus plain leather bracers and small brass ear-studs, carrying a long matchlock musket with dark wooden stock and iron barrel in his hands and a small powder horn at his belt; beside him stands Turbak Khan, a broader wheat-brown man with a square weathered face, stern eyes, short trimmed beard and moustache, wearing a conical steel helmet with a small nasal bar over a padded cloth coif, a long dusty olive-green quilted coat reaching mid-calf over a pale beige tunic and wide dark brown trousers, a dark leather belt, sturdy black leather boots, a simple steel breastplate strapped over the coat, and leather forearm guards, with a curved single-edged sword in his right hand and a small wheeled bronze cannon on a wooden carriage with rope lashings positioned at his side; keep colours in muted indigo, deep red, cream, olive green, and brown leather, and show both figures clearly head-to-toe with consistent hairstyles, armour, and weapons for reuse across panels.
